stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: Why is Morag still on the list?

stations.title: Phone call
stations.text: Her booking, read in again as a new object

captions: The Gannet's waiting list. Bridie took Morag off it, and she is still there.
The booking from Morag's call is a new object, so the list never finds hers.
You write when two bookings are the same, a hash code to match, and the cancelling.
Now the list finds the booking equal to the call, and Morag comes off.
A booking read in finds its equal on the list. Next: kinds of ticket.
